Title: Visual Studio Codespaces: New OS Support & GitHub integration

Body.Content: Visual Studio Codespaces (previously known as Visual Studio Online) enables developers to work remotely from anywhere with cloud-hosted development environments that can be created in seconds. After lowering pricing and announcing GitHub integration a few weeks ago, today we’re announcing a private preview for Windows-based codespaces, and VS2019 support. To learn more, visit the Visual Studio Codespaces blog.
